verdict.rationale: Ramp's Bill Pay explicitly describes AI reading vendor invoices, auto-matching to POs, auto-coding to GL accounts, and routing for approval/payment before user review — directly matching the story. This is corroborated by AI-powered intake parsing contracts/screenshots to auto-populate forms, showing a broader pattern of AI-assisted document-to-data population. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of bill-reading accuracy and no detailed breakdown of what fields are auto-populated vs. manually reviewed.
